Definition: Integration of voter registration data for identity verification, demographic analysis, and service delivery targeting
Comments: No evidence of electoral register integration with a data exchange platform found. The interoperability platform is still at planning stage.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: Confirmed. Both the 50in5 country profile (Dec 2024) and the National Digital Transformation Strategy: Agenda 2030 (policyvault copy) describe Lesotho's cross-government data exchange as a whole-of-government enterprise architecture and interoperability framework still at planning stage, with government platforms described in the Strategy as 'highly fragmented and not designed to support interoperability'. A February 2026 MICSTI/National University of Lesotho review of prospective tools (X-Road, MOSIP, a Decision Support System) confirms these remain at an early review/pilot stage, with no mention of electoral commission data being shared through any exchange. No source found references voter register integration specifically. Score of 0 confirmed.
revised_comments: Lesotho has no operational cross-government data exchange platform through which electoral register data could be shared. The national interoperability framework, being developed by the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation, remains under development, and the country's government data platforms are described as fragmented and not built for interoperability. A 2026 technical review of prospective interoperability tools remains at an early conceptual stage, with no reference to electoral commission data integration. No evidence exists of voter registration data being shared through any government exchange mechanism.

revised_comments: There is no confirmed integration of national statistics, census or administrative data into a cross-government data exchange platform in Lesotho. A Decision Support System intended to help government analyse data for planning, budgeting and service delivery has been presented in an academic-government review, indicating early interest in this functionality, though no implementation timeline, funding commitment or formal adoption has been confirmed.

However, no public dashboard, formal annual reporting mechanism, or detailed operational disclosure on the data exchange/interoperability platform specifically was found, consistent with 'Low = Limited Disclosure' (code 2). Score of 2 confirmed; year updated to reflect the continuing pattern of ad hoc disclosure through early 2026, though the core evidence base remains the 2024 Strategy publication.
revised_comments: The Government of Lesotho publishes its National Digital Transformation Strategy 2024-2030 and issues periodic public updates on digital public infrastructure progress through its official web portal, including announcements on interoperability and data governance initiatives. However, there is no public dashboard, standardised annual reporting mechanism, or detailed disclosure specifically covering data exchange operations, governance arrangements, or data-sharing agreements, reflecting a low level of public transparency.
